releaseNotes:
- Lunaverse Agent is restored on the optimized Cline runtime, including the latest reliability, exact-ticket DAG, recovery, tracing, and workspace Skill improvements
- IDE authoring now connects directly to IDE Cloud for identity, models, Styles, Voice, tools, concurrency claims, publishing, and observability without App-local author routing
- Voice and release TTS controls now live in IDE Cloud while the existing App TTS runtime continues provider execution and durable R2 audio storage through a private service contract
releaseNotesZh:
- Lunaverse Agent 已恢复为优化后的 Cline 运行时，并保留最新的可靠性、精确票据 DAG、恢复、追踪与工作区 Skill 改进
- IDE 作者能力现直接连接 IDE Cloud，统一承载身份、模型、画风、声音、工具、并发 Claim、发布与可观测性，不再依赖 App 本地作者路由
- 声音与预制 TTS 控制面现由 IDE Cloud 管理，既有 App TTS 运行时则通过私有服务合同继续负责真实合成与持久 R2 音频存储
